name: gla_state_decay_matrix_solve
hypothesis: Now that the output stage lands its rows in token order, the GLA state stage is what is left, and it is the only stage still built as a sequential grid: its Pallas launch is indexed by (head, chunk) with the running state carried through a VMEM scratch across the chunk axis, so the head axis REPLICATES the entire program H times and the chunk axis cannot start until its predecessor has finished. Nothing about the mathematics requires either. The stage computes S_t = exp(gamma*L_t) * S_{t-1} + C_t with C_t = K_t^T (V_t * decay) and reports each chunk's ENTRANCE state plus each sequence's final state; unrolling that recurrence once gives E_t = exp(P_t - P_f(t)) * h0 + sum_{j<t} exp(P_t - P_{j+1}) * C_j, where P is the running sum of the chunk decay exponents. Every exponent in that form is a sum of gamma*L terms over an interval and gamma is negative, so each one is NON-POSITIVE and the whole carry is a single strictly-lower-triangular decay matrix that cannot overflow -- unlike the exp(-P_{j+1}) factorization, which would overflow by chunk 30 at these gates. The variant therefore emits two contractions and one triangular matrix: C over the batched (head, chunk) pair, and the carry as one (NT, NT) decay matrix per head. The head axis stops replicating the program, the chunk axis stops being sequential, and the same sum is re-associated rather than approximated -- no term is dropped, and the padding rows the incumbent kills with a -1e9 exponent are killed by an exact zero here. The incumbent grid stays the bit-identical default.

estimate.reasoning: SHARE: the incumbent additive DP cost of the only locally-runnable model is 11.4217ms and the action's two affected callsites are 13.68% of it -- gla-long 0.8165ms = 7.15% and gla-short 0.7463ms = 6.53% (kda-long/kda-short hold 55.1%/28.2% and input-projection 3.0%). LOCALIZATION: a stage decomposition of the two incumbent-selected plans, timed under the same deterministic-XLA regime the frozen gate evaluates in, puts the STATE stage at 0.5476ms of gla-long's 0.9123ms stage sum (70.6%) and 0.5194ms of gla-short's 0.8466ms (74.9%); the input alignment gather is 9.1%/6.9% and the output stage 34.3%/33.5%. The state stage is also nearly shape-independent (0.5476ms at T=2048 vs 0.5194ms at T=512, a 16x work difference), which identifies it as grid/replication overhead rather than arithmetic -- exactly what this action removes. MEASURED: the state stage alone, at the DP-selected chunk sizes, goes from 0.5499ms to 0.1089ms (5.05x) at gla-long and keeps improving as the chunk axis lengthens (22.5x at chunk_size=512, 77x at 128, 156x at 64, 229x at 16), matching the frozen pure-JAX state to 6.6e-7 worst case against a 1e-3 tolerance. END TO END, a full 448-configuration paired sweep of the extended deployment space on this host -- every configuration checked against the frozen reference and all 448 correct -- takes gla-long's best deployable config from 0.7783ms to 0.3224ms (58.58%, incumbent cs=2048/ca=True/ovt=8 vs variant cs=2048/ca=True/ovt=8) and gla-short's from 0.6974ms to 0.2587ms (62.90%, variant cs=512/ca=True/ovt=4). AGGREGATE: 0.0715*58.58 + 0.0653*62.90 = 4.19 + 4.11 = 8.30% of the additive cost, i.e. 0.948ms off the 10.580ms paired incumbent (8.96%). DISCOUNT: cut to 8.0% to leave room for the gate's own timing methodology and for the DP re-selecting other callsites. Even attributing only the smaller callsite's win it clears the 2% bar at 0.0653*62.90 = 4.1%.
estimate.prior_estimate_note: The one previous attempt on this slot (gla_state_head_grouping, estimated 6.0%, measured 9.95%, rejected on the since-fixed nondeterministic workload fingerprint) grouped heads into one program while KEEPING the sequential per-chunk scratch carry. This proposal is not that: it removes the launch's sequential chunk axis as well, by resolving the carry in closed form as a non-positive-exponent decay matrix, and it is measured against a completely different baseline -- the state stage was 4-14% of each GLA callsite then and is 70-75% now that the aligned-space scatter is gone.
